19. RESOLUTION ~ Approving water services, by outside user agreement, for properties to
be known as Ironhorse 3" Filing, Laramie County, Wyoming generally located southeast
of West Riding Club Road and Hynds Boulevard. (POSTPONED FROM JUNE 26, 2023)

The item died due to the lack of a motion.

No staff report was available. Matt Kauffman, developer, was available for questions, Committee
member Aldrich commented on the item and public comment was made by Michael White.

24, RESOLUTION — Pursuant to Wyoming Statute § 15-9-106 Finding and Declaring Jolly
Rogers and Expanded Downtown in the City of Cheyenne as blight and authorizing the
redevelopment thereof, (SPONSORS ~ MR. JOHNSON AND MR. WHITE)

‘The item died due to the lack of a motion.

Lonnie Olson, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and committee
members Aldrich and Laybourn commented on the item.

25. RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Sunrise
Hills North Subdivision, a replat of a portion of Tract 25, Dell Range Addition, Laramie
County, Wyoming (located northwest of and adjacent to the intersection of Thomas Road
and Ridge Road) (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Kelly Schroeder,
AVIP.C., and Bernie Lowerly, applicant, provided additional information. Committee member
Laybourn commented on the item.

26. RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for
Christensen Park, 2" Filing, a Replat of Lot 15, Christensen Park, City of Cheyenne,
Laramie County, Wyoming (located northwest of the intersection of Cribbon Avenue and
Dodge Ct.) (SPONSOR — MR. COOK)

Dr. Aldrich moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
